What Apple Priority Notifications is — and what your listing may claim

Apple markets Priority Notifications (also framed as Apple Intelligence Priority Notifications in en-US copy) under Settings → Notifications → Priority Notifications. Buyers choose which apps or alert types surface first — time-sensitive notifications break through immediately while less urgent pings may wait. Western indie listings often show one or more of these surfaces on the US product page. AppLocale covers paste-ready zh-Hans copy for whichever your screenshots and description already claim:
